headline: Final details for the Fall 2026 program, plus updates on the Celebration, State of World Health, and Visioning working groups.
summary: The celebration working group gets the most time, 30 minutes. The fall program details also get 30 minutes, followed by shorter updates.
items: Celebration program working group update (30 minutes)
State of World Health working group update (10 minutes)
location: Sawyer Free Library Conference Room, 2 Dale Ave, Gloucester, MA 01930

2. Approval of Minutes for September 10 and October 15, 2026
